newsitem.title: FRANCE: SGB near Accor stake sale - fund managers.
newsitem.headline: SGB near Accor stake sale - fund managers.

text.p: Societe Generale de Belgique, a subsidiary of French financial group Cie de Suez, is on the verge of selling its holdings in French hotel company Accor, fund managers said on Thursday.
They said they had been sounded out about their interest.
No one at Accor was immediately available to comment.
SGB's stake in Accor was nine percent at the end of last June.
Four fund managers said they had been contacted by an intermediary sounding out their interest in Accor shares.
Shares in Accor were two percent lower at 734 francs at 1208 GMT.
Bourse operators speculate the sale may have been pushed back because of a large placement on Wednesday night and Thursday of Rhone-Poulenc shares sold by state holding Consortium de Realisation.
